rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After returning from annihilation to subsistence to guide creation, the Prophet's heart is veiled, and his self appears through its attributes at intervals, producing spiritual variegation.
rows.anchor: لما رد في مقام البقاء بعد الفناء إلى حجاب القلب لهداية الخلق كان قد يظهر نفسه وقتا غب وقت على قلبه بصفاتها، ويحدث له التلوين بسببها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God repeatedly restores and disciplines the Prophet through revelation and spiritual attraction, admonishing him so he returns and repents in every state until firmly established.
rows.anchor: فكان يتداركه الله تعالى بإنزال الوحي والجذبة ويؤدبه ويعاتبه فيرجع إليه في كل حال ويتوب

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says his Lord educated him and perfected his education.
rows.anchor: قال عليه السلام: " أدبني ربي فأحسن تأديبي "

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet reports a recurring clouding of his heart and says he seeks God's forgiveness seventy times each day.
rows.anchor: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم: " إنه ليغان على قلبي وإني لأستغفر الله في اليوم سبعين مرة "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prophetic trial arose through the call, which exposed him to people's harm, enmity, and opposition.
rows.anchor: وكان سبب ظهور ابتلاء الله تعالى إياه بالدعوة لإيذاء الناس إياه وعداوتهم ومناصبتهم له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One wisdom of the trial is the Prophet's own perfection: facing enemies of varied natures teaches him the wisdom and virtue of every attribute, bringing together the noble traits and perfections of all prophets.
rows.anchor: فيؤدبه الله بحكمة وجود كل صفة وفضيلة كل قوة، فيحصل له جميع مكارم الأخلاق وكمالات جميع الأنبياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart's differing aspects, arising through the soul's attributes, make it receptive to diverse wisdoms and virtues as its orientation becomes particular to each.
rows.anchor: لولا الجهات المختلفة في القلب بواسطة صفات النفس لما استعد لقبول الحكم المتفننة والفضائل بتخصص توجهه لكل واحدة منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A second wisdom is for the community: as messenger to people of diverse capacities, he needs comprehensive wisdom, virtues, and morals to guide, purify, and teach each according to their aptitude.
rows.anchor: فإنه رسول إلى الكل واستعداداتهم متباينة، ونفوسهم في الصفات متفاوتة. فيجب أن يكون فيه جوامع الحكم والكلم والفضائل والأخلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an's gradual descent matches the changing emergence of the Prophet's attributes over time and steadies him in the complete path toward, with, and from God; he is a model for seekers, realized ones, and those who perfect others.
rows.anchor: كون التنزيل مفرقا منجما إنما يكون بحسب اختلاف صفات نفسه في الظهور منها على أوقاته موجبا لتثبت قلبه في الاستقامة في السلوك إلى الله، وفي الله عند الاتصاف بصفاته، ومن الله في هداية الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tartil means spacing each portion of revelation from the next long enough for it to settle firmly in the heart and become a stable disposition rather than a passing state.
rows.anchor: والترتيل هو أن يتخلل بين كل نجم وآخر مدة يمكن فيها تزايله في قلبه ويترسخ ويصير ملكة لا حالا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night is the soul's darkness, a garment that envelops people and veils them from witnessing the Real, its attributes, and Essence during worldly heedlessness.
rows.anchor: ليل ظلمة النفس { لباسا } يغشاكم بالاستيلاء عن مشاهدة الحق وصفاته والذات وظلالها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sleep signifies being cut off from everlasting true life.
rows.anchor: تسبتون بها عن الحياة الحقيقية السرمدية كما قال عليه السلام

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says people are asleep and awaken when they die.
rows.anchor: قال عليه السلام: " الناس نيام فإذا ماتوا انتبهوا "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Day is the light of the spirit; it revives hearts, which spread into the space of holiness after sensory sleep.
rows.anchor: نهار نور الروح { نشورا } تحيا قلوبكم به فتنتشرون في فضاء القدس بعد نوم الحس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The winds are life-giving breaths of divine grace, or heralding breaths before the mercy of perfection through the manifestation of attributes.
rows.anchor: رياح النفحات الربانية ناشرة محيية أو مبشرة بين يدي رحمة الكمال بتجلي الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Water from the heaven of the spirit is knowledge that purifies people of vices, base nature, corrupt beliefs, and destructive ignorance.
rows.anchor: من سماء الروح ماء العلم { طهورا } مطهرا يطهركم عن لوث الرذائل ورجس الطبائع والعقائد الفاسدة والجهالات المفسدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dead land is a heart dead through ignorance; the many animals are the soul's powers nourished by beneficial practical sciences, while the many people are spiritual powers nourished by theoretical sciences.
rows.anchor: من القوى النفسانية بالعلوم النافعة العملية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham asks for steadfast realization at the station of subsistence, wisdom and judgment through the Real, and inclusion among those made causes of the world's reform and creation's perfection.
rows.anchor: أي: حكمة وحكما بالحق لأكون من الذين جعلتهم سببا لصلاح العالم وكمال الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God makes him beloved, so creation loves him through God's love and remembers him favorably across generations; mentioning remembrance stands for the thing remembered.
rows.anchor: إذ لا بد لمن يحب شيئا من كثرة ذكره بالخير ذكر اللازم مكان الملزوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A sound heart is free both of deficiency in its original aptitude and of the veils of the soul's attributes in embodied life.
rows.anchor: وسلامة القلب بأمرين: براءته عن نقص الاستعداد في الفطرة، ونزاهته عن حجب صفات النفس في النشأة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prophets in this chapter can each symbolize spirit or heart, while their people's denial symbolizes the soul's powers refusing spiritual discipline and the morals of perfected people.
rows.anchor: يمكن أن يؤول كل نبي مذكور فيها بالروح أو القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In this allegory, the prophet's call to fear God means avoiding vices, and being a trustworthy messenger means conveying received certain truths without admixture of illusion or fantasy.
rows.anchor: أؤدي إليكم ما تلقفت من الحق من الحكم والمعاني اليقينية غير مخلوطة بالوهميات والتخيلات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who disbelieve in the afterlife are veiled by the soul's beautification of its perfections and deeds, blinding their inner sight to the Real's attributes and their manifestations.
rows.anchor: من المحجوبين بتزين نفوسهم بكمالاتها وهيئات أعمالها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their severe punishment is the fire of veiling and deprivation from the pleasures of divine attribute manifestations.
rows.anchor: بنيران الحجاب والحرمان عن لذات تجليات الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hereafter here means the great resurrection, the station of unveiling the Essence; they are greatest losers because their veils of self and attributes thicken and they have no share in either garden or its pleasures.
rows.anchor: ومقام كشف الذات في القيامة الكبرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The received Qur'an is the Qur'anic intellect, from the source of the unity of attributes, with no veil between it and the divine presence; it is itself the holiest veil.
rows.anchor: من عين جمع الوحدة في الصفات الأول الذي لا حجاب بينه وبين الحضرة الأحدية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This sacred veil pours every preparedness from the discriminating intellects to their human fixed entities; its wisdom is complete and its knowledge all-encompassing.
rows.anchor: المفيض لكل الاستعدادات من العقول الفرقانية على أربابها من الأعيان الثابتة الإنسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses is the heart, his family the soul and outer and inner senses; his order to wait means remain still and do not disturb his moment with activity.
rows.anchor: من النفس والحواس الظاهرة والباطنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses perceives with the eye of insight the fire of the active intellect and seeks knowledge of the path to God, which he had lost while tending animal powers and the animal soul.
rows.anchor: بعين البصيرة { نارا } أي: نار وما أعظمها هي نار العقل والفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, he brings a luminous flame from his contact with the intellect; its warmth frees his family from bodily attachment and stirs longing for the divine gardens and love's journey to the breast.
rows.anchor: بشعلة نورية تشرق عليكم حين اتصالي بالنار وتنوري بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were turned from the path so they would not submit and bring their potential perfections into actuality in the intellect.
rows.anchor: فصدهم عن السبيل لئلا ينقادوا ويذعنوا في إخراج كمالاتهم إلى العقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hidden treasure is possible perfection concealed in the heavens of spirits and the earth of the body.
rows.anchor: المخبوء من الكمالات الممكنة في سموات الأرواح وأرض الجسم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows latent perfections blocked from intellect by veiling actions as well as the dark dispositions and ruinous morals people manifest.
rows.anchor: مما فيهم بالقوة من الكمالات بالأعمال الحاجبة والمانعة لخروج ما في الاستعداد إلى العقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God alone is deity, worship and submission are due to no one else.
rows.anchor: فلا يجوز التعبد والانقياد إلا له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's throne encompasses everything; the soul's throne represented by Bilqis is tiny beside it, so loving that throne should not veil her from obedience.
rows.anchor: المحيط بكل شيء، فما أصغر عرش بلقيس النفس في جنب عظمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The test distinguishes a truthful account, examined through rational inquiry into their misguidance and state, from falsehood that follows illusion and corrupt imaginings.
rows.anchor: في تضليلهم والإحاطة بأحوالهم بالطريق العقلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning Moses to his mother symbolizes his inclination toward and reception by the reproaching soul, which is illumined by his light and consoled for the beauty and strength it had lost.
rows.anchor: النفس اللوامة بالميل نحوها والإقبال { كي تقر عينها } بالتنور بنوره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's promise is that each prepared being reaches its deposited perfection and every reality returns to its origin; most people fail to seek their latent perfection because of veils and doubt.
rows.anchor: بإيصال كل مستعد إلى كماله المودع فيه وإعادة كل حقيقة إلى أصلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reaching maturity signifies the station of spiritual youth and perfected primordial nature; becoming established means attaining perfection and then detaching from the soul and its attributes.
rows.anchor: استقام بحصول كماله ثم بتجرده عن النفس وصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wisdom and knowledge bestowed are theoretical and practical wisdom.
rows.anchor: آتيناه حكما وعلما } أي: حكمة نظرية وعملية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people rewarded as doers of good are those endowed with virtues and walking the path of justice.
rows.anchor: المحسنين } المتصفين بالفضائل، السائرين في طريق العدالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The water of Midian is the source and spring of unveiling, secret knowledge, and spiritual converse.
rows.anchor: مورد علم المكاشفة ومنهل علم السر والمكالمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people watering there may be saints and wayfarers in God, whose drink is unveiling and who give it to their powers and disciples.
rows.anchor: من الأولياء والسالكين في الله والمتوسطين الذين مشربهم من منهل المكاشفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, they are the sacred intellects and disembodied spirits of the realm of power, the true inhabitants of this spring, watering celestial and human souls and the cosmos.
rows.anchor: أو العقول المقدسة والأرواح المجردة من أهل الجبروت فإنها في الحقيقة أهل ذلك المنهل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two women symbolize the theoretical and practical intellects, at a lower rank than the saints and spirits at the spring.
rows.anchor: من مرتبة أسفل من مرتبتهم { امرأتين } هما العاقلتان النظرية والعملية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They hold the flock of faculties back from the spring because their sustenance is rational knowledge and practical philosophy; they lack unveiling until Moses the heart arrives.
rows.anchor: أغنام القوى عنه لكون مشربها من العلوم العقلية والحكمة العملية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They drink from the holy spirits' and intellects' surplus when those shepherds depart from the spring and turn toward them, imparting its overflow.
rows.anchor: شربنا من فضلة رعاء الأرواح والعقول المقدسة عند صدورها عن المنهل متوجهة إلينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their father is the spirit, too great and old to undertake watering.
rows.anchor: أكبر من أن يقوم بالسقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses waters them from the spring of his own taste and unveiling; when the heart reaches it, all faculties receive its outpouring and are illuminated.
rows.anchor: من مشرب ذوقه ومنهل كشفه بالإفاضة على جميع القوى من فيضه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He then turns to the soul's shade at the station of the breast, deeming rational knowledge inferior to unveiling and drawing on divine overflow and direct, bestowed knowledge.
rows.anchor: أي: ظل النفس في مقام الصدر مستحقرا لعلمه المعقول بالنسبة إلى العلوم الكشفية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hiring Moses means employing him in spiritual struggle and watchfulness, tending the faculties so they do not scatter and disrupt one's collectedness.
rows.anchor: استعمله بالمجاهدة في الله والمراقبة لحاله في رعاية أغنام القوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His work also entails heart-remembrance amid the manifestations of attributes and spiritual travel through them; its wage is the reward of those manifestations and unveiling knowledge.
rows.anchor: وبالذكر القلبي في مقام تجليات الصفات والسير فيها بأجره ثواب التجليات وعلوم المكاشفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The best worker is strong in acquiring perfection and trustworthy in fulfilling God's covenant by bringing its deposit of latent perfection into actuality.
rows.anchor: الذي لا يخون عهد الله بالوفاء بإبرازها في الاستعداد من وديعته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, trustworthiness means not betraying the spirit by inclining to its daughters and becoming veiled by intelligible things.
rows.anchor: أو لا يخون الروح بالميل إلى بناته فيحتجب بالمعقول

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: It is said that shepherds used a well-covering stone that seven or ten men could lift, but Moses lifted it alone, signaling his strength.
rows.anchor: وقد قيل: إن الرعاة كانوا يضعون على رأس البئر حجرا لا يقله إلا سبعة رجال، وقيل عشرة، فأقله وحده وذلك قوته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stone's seven or ten lifters also signify that bestowed knowledge comes only through embodying the seven or ten divine attributes.
rows.anchor: وفيها إشارة إلى أن العلم اللدني لا يحصل إلا بالاتصاف بالصفات السبع الإلهية أو العشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Giving one daughter in marriage means bringing her under the heart's command so she receives holy light and unveiling knowledge without veiling it.
rows.anchor: قال إني أريد أن أنكحك إحدى ابنتي هاتين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eight years of service signify striving through eight stages: annihilation through the seven divine attributes, ending in intimate speech; a stage of witnessing completes the sought arrival.
rows.anchor: هي أطوار الصفات السبعة الإلهية بالفناء عن صفاته في صفات الله التي آخرها مقام المكالمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Completing ten signifies two further stages, annihilation in the Essence and subsistence afterward; this depends on one's aptitude and the ten perfections Abraham completed before being made a leader.
rows.anchor: هما الفناء في الذات والبقاء بعده بالتحقق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: David symbolizes the spirit, given rank, the glorification and intimacy of witnessing in love, increased worship and reflection, and scientific and practical perfections.
rows.anchor: بعلو الرتبة وتسبيح المشاهدة والمناغاة في المحبة مع مزيد العبادة والتفكر والكمالات العلمية العملية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains are bodily members, ordered to glorify through their particular obedience, practice, motions, stillness, and deeds.
rows.anchor: من الانقياد والتمرن في الطاعات بالحركات والسكنات والأفعال والانفعالات التي أمرناك بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The birds are spiritual powers, glorifying through holy remembrances, perceptions, reasoning, receptivity, and illumination from disembodied spirits.
rows.anchor: وطير القوى الروحانية بالتسبيحات القدسية من الأذكار والإدراكات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The iron softened for David is elemental bodily nature.
rows.anchor: وألنا له } حديد الطبيعة الجسمانية العنصرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ample coats of mail symbolize forms of scrupulous piety, a protective garment against the soul's hostile impulses and Satan's arrows.
rows.anchor: من هيئات الورع والتقوى فإن الورع الحصين في الحقيقة هو لباس الورع الحافظ من صوارم دواعي أعادي النفوس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Proportioning the links signifies practical wisdom and skilled rational and religious craft that encourages purifying deeds and forms that prevent the soul's promptings from taking effect.
rows.anchor: بالحكمة العملية والصنعة المتقنة العقلية والشرعية في ترغيب الأعمال المزكية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command addresses those working for God, gathering from the lower realm toward the upper; righteous work raises them toward the divine presence and prepares them to receive holy lights. David is the spirit with its faculties and bodily members.
rows.anchor: أيها العاملون لله بالجمعية في الجهة السفلية إلى الجهة العلوية عملا صالحا يصعدكم في الترقي إلى الحضرة الإلهية

words: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their praise comes when they attain all praiseworthy attributes in subsistence after annihilation: God removes grief over unrealized possible perfections by granting them in true divine existence.
rows.anchor: بألسنة أحوالهم وأقوالهم عند اتصافهم بجميع الصفات الحميدة حالة البقاء بعد الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their Lord's reward is more abundant and enduring than their efforts merit.
rows.anchor: جزاؤنا منه أوفى وأبقى مما نستحقه بسعينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The everlasting abode is a permanent state in existence bestowed from pure generosity; there is no toil from striving or transition and no fatigue of travel.
rows.anchor: الإقامة الدائمة التي لا انتقال منها بوجه في هذا الوجود الموهوب من عطائه الصرف وفضله المحض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers are those veiled from the addressee by denial, who reject and do not inherit the Book because they are truly distant from him, with no closeness or connection.
rows.anchor: المحجوبون منك بالإنكار، الذين لا يقبلون الكتاب ولا يرثونه لبعدهم عنك في الحقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their fire is the hell of nature, where they suffer unending deprivation and pain, with neither death to relieve them nor easing of torment.
rows.anchor: الطبيعة يعذبون فيها بأنواع الحرمان والآلام دائما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night signifies the soul's darkness; its peeling away is the day and the sun of the spirit and its changing states, after which people are left in darkness.
rows.anchor: ليل ظلمة النفس { نسلخ منه } نهار ونور شمس الروح والتلوين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun's resting place is the Real's station at the end of the spirit's journey; the Mighty is inaccessible and conquers all through annihilation, while the Knowing knows each traveler's limit and completion.
rows.anchor: وهو مقام الحق في نهاية سير الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The moon symbolizes the heart, whose course passes through stations such as fear, hope, patience, gratitude, trust, and contentment.
rows.anchor: قدرنا مسيره في سيره { منازل } من الخوف والرجاء والصبر والشكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The old curved palm stalk represents the heart as it approaches absorption in the spirit at the station of the secret, its face toward the spirit illuminated before its full annihilation there.
rows.anchor: عند فنائه في الروح في مقام السر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart's luminosity veils it from the soul and faculties; it is full when situated in the breast facing the station of the secret.
rows.anchor: واحتجابه لنوريته عن النفس والقوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Avoiding worship of anything besides God and turning to Him means pure monotheism, whose glad tidings are the encounter with God.
rows.anchor: عبادة الغير { وأنابوا إلى الله } بالتوحيد المحض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servants to be given glad tidings are those singled out by God's special care.
rows.anchor: فبشر عباد } المخصوصين بعنايتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sayings heard include strict rulings and dispensations, and obligatory and recommended acts, whether attributed to God or others.
rows.anchor: كالعزائم والرخص والواجب والمندوب في قول الحق والغير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Following the best means choosing strict rulings over dispensations and obligations over recommendations, although each item of speech is true.
rows.anchor: كالعزائم دون الرخص والواجب دون المندوب والقول حق في الكل لا غير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God guides them by original guidance; their liberated inner cores distinguish sayings and receive verified meanings.
rows.anchor: إليه بنور الهداية الأصلية { وأولئك هم أولو الألباب } المميزون بين الأقوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question means the Prophet is not master of their affairs: he cannot rescue one whose wretchedness was decreed.
rows.anchor: أأنت مالك أمرهم فمن سبق الحكم بشقاوته فأنت تنقذه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The God-fearing are people of unity who abstract themselves from attachment to their acts, attributes, and selves.
rows.anchor: أفعالهم وصفاتهم وذواتهم في التجريد والتفريد من أهل التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stacked chambers represent ascending stations: trust in God through annihilation of acts, contentment through annihilation of attributes, and annihilation in the Essence.
rows.anchor: مقامات وأحوال بعضها فوق بعض كالتوكل بفناء الأفعال فوقه، الرضاء بفناء الصفات فوقه الفناء في الذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rivers flowing beneath the chambers are streams of unveiling knowledge.
rows.anchor: تجري من تحتها } أنهار علوم المكاشفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sky is the spirit and its rain is knowledge, which sends springs of wisdom into souls according to their capacities.
rows.anchor: الحكم في أراضي النفوس بحسب استعدادتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The crop represents deeds and morals, whose kinds vary with the different powers and bodily members.
rows.anchor: أصنافه بحسب اختلاف القوى والأعضاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The crop's withering signifies separation from its root through the lights of manifestations and its fading as the powers, souls, and hearts that upheld it are annihilated.
rows.anchor: فينقطع عن أصله بأنوار التجليات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The crop becomes fragments when divine attributes appear and become established through spiritual realization.
rows.anchor: بذهابه وانكساره وانقشاعه عند ظهور صفاته تعالى واستقرارها بالتمكين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of inner cores are spiritual realities stripped of the shell of egohood.
rows.anchor: الحقائق المجردة من قشرة الأنائية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Despair signals lost spiritual aptitude, departure from primordial nature through veiling, and severed connection with God; retaining a trace of original light lets even a deeply wayward person recognize mercy and hope for its reach.
rows.anchor: فإن القنوط علامة زوال الاستعداد والسقوط عن الفطرة بالاحتجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only total veiling brings despair: turning from the upper world and being covered by the material veil of created nature.
rows.anchor: وإنما اليأس لا يكون إلا مع الاحتجاب الكلي واسوداد الوجه بالإعراض عن العالم العلوي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgiveness of all sins is conditional on the heart retaining the light of monotheism; the address as God's servants signals their relation to Him.
rows.anchor: بشرط بقاء نور التوحيد في القلب

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: It is said that God forgives all sins for the monotheists of Muhammad's community, unlike other communities; Noah's people are told He will forgive them some sins.
rows.anchor: ولهذا قيل: يغفر جميعها للأمة المحمدية الموحدين دون سائر الأمم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Forgiving removes dispositions of excess and deficiency, while the Merciful bestows virtues.
rows.anchor: الفغور } لهئيات الرذائل من الإفراط والتفريط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The universal religion prescribed to all prophets is the common foundation they must establish without division: monotheism, justice, and belief in God and the afterlife.
rows.anchor: المطلق الذي وصى جميع الأنبياء بإقامته واجتماعهم عليه وعدم تفرقهم فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shared religion concerns unchanging knowledge and deeds, while differing revealed laws concern changing practices, worship, and transactions, as 5:48 says each community has a law and a way.
rows.anchor: فالدين القيم هو المتعلق بما لا يتغير من العلوم والأعمال، والشريعة هي المتعلقة بما يتغير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Monotheism weighs heavily on polytheists because they are veiled by attachment to other-than-God and stand among manifestations of wrath, not the beloved or those guided to turn toward God.
rows.anchor: المحجوبين عن الحق بالغير { ما تدعوهم إليه } من التوحيد لكونهم أهل المقت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God draws the beloved to Him before spiritual discipline through prior election; those who love Him are enabled to turn through wayfaring, effort, longing, and need, then guided by His light and beauty.
rows.anchor: المحبوبين الذين اجتباهم الله بمحض عنايته ومجرد مشيئته ولا من المحبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those veiled from God are expelled from His door and distanced from His presence by a prior decree of wretchedness.
rows.anchor: وطرد المحجوبين عن بابه وأبعدهم عن جنابه بسابقة كلمة القضاء عليهم بالشقاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The garden promised to those entering it is the garden of the soul, shared by both groups, unlike the gardens of attributes and Essence reserved for the foremost; the author supports this from 43:72 and 43:71.
rows.anchor: والجنة التي أمروا بدخولها هي جنة النفس لاشتراك الفريقين فيها دون جنتي الصفات والذات المخصوصتين بالسابقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The keeper of Hell is called Malik because he serves those who owned the world and preferred it.
rows.anchor: سمي خازن النار مالكا لاختصاصه بمن ملك الدنيا وآثرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The keeper of the garden is called Ridwan because he is associated with those with whom God is pleased and who are pleased with Him.
rows.anchor: كما سمى خازن الجنة رضوانا لاختصاصه بمن رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An alternative says contentment with God's decree is the greatest gate to Him and identifies Malik with bodily nature, dark matter, or the universal animal soul governing bodies.
rows.anchor: وقيل: الرضا بالقضاء باب الله الأعظم وهو الطبيعة الجسمانية الموكلة بأجساد العالم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire is a garden for its keeper, who shares its substance, but torment for the people of Hell because their essences differ from and conflict with it.
rows.anchor: وإنما لا يتعذب بالنار لكونه من جوهر تلك النار فهي له جنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They call Malik rather than God because they are wholly veiled from and distant from God, and their intentions and wishes were devoted to Malik.
rows.anchor: واختصاص ندائهم بمالك دون الله تعالى لاحتجابهم وبعدهم عن الله بالكلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their plea for death means wishing either to lose every remaining capacity and innate disposition so painful forms cease, or to lose sensation because bodily punishment is intense.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى تمني زوال بقية الاستعداد بالكلية وإماتة الغريزة الفطرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their duration depends on rooted dispositions and accumulated sins if capacity and sound belief remain, or is eternal otherwise.
rows.anchor: إن كانت الاستعدادات باقية والاعتقادات صحيحة أو الخلود فيها إن لم تكن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Duration is broader than eternity, and sinner broader than primordial wretch; accordingly 43:74 may describe a long stay figuratively or everlasting punishment if it refers only to the eternally rejected.
rows.anchor: وكذا المجرم أعم من الشقي الأصلي وغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every fruit means all the delights of the three gardens, enjoyed without fear of losing or being deprived of them.
rows.anchor: كل ما يتلذذ به من لذائذ الجنان الثلاث

words: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first death is bodily nature; it does not exclude voluntary annihilation of acts, attributes, and Essence, since each such death is a purer and more delightful life, each in its own garden.
rows.anchor: أي: الطبيعة الجسمانية لا الفناء من الأفعال والصفات والذات فإن كل فناء منها وإن كان موتا إراديا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God protects them from the hell of deprivation arising from a remaining residue, much less from the hell of bodily nature.
rows.anchor: أي: جحيم الحرمان بوجود البقية فضلا عن الخذلان في جحيم الطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This great success is pure gift and generosity from the Lord: bestowed divine existence as the soul's faculties fade away.
rows.anchor: موهبة محضة وعطاء صرفا من ربك بالوجود الحقاني عند تلاشي الآلات النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation is by the Real's absolute, established, unique existence that sustains everything, or by justice, the shadow of unity that orders multiplicity; the latter is supported by the saying that heaven and earth stand through justice.
rows.anchor: بالوجود المطلق الثابت الأحدي الصمدي الذي يتقوم به كل شيء، أو بالعدل الذي هو ظل الوحدة المنتظم به كل كثرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The appointed term is a determinate perfection ending existence: the great resurrection, with the Mahdi's appearance and the One, Subduer's manifestation in unifying existence where all things perish as in the beginning.
rows.anchor: كمال معين ينتهي به كمال الوجود وهو القيامة الكبرى بظهور المهدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelievers are veiled from the Real and turn away from the warned-of resurrection.
rows.anchor: بالاحتجاب عن الحق { عما أنذروا } من أمر هذه القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling upon others besides God means naming them and ascribing existence or causal power to them; the challenge asks what they created or affected independently in earth or jointly in heaven.
rows.anchor: تسمونه وتثبتون له وجودا وتأثير أي شيء كان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The requested evidence could be transmitted from an earlier scripture or rational proof grounded in sound knowledge.
rows.anchor: على ذلك بدليل نقلي من كتاب سابق أو عقلي من علم متقن

words: وَمَنْ أَضَلَّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling on other-than-God is like a servant calling a master, since only God answers the call.
rows.anchor: أي شيء كدعاء الموالي للسادة مثلا إذ لا يستجيب له أحد إلا الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At resurrection the invoked become enemies because worldly service was self-interested, as 43:67 says; they deny having been served.
rows.anchor: لأن عبادة أهل الدنيا لسادتهم وخدمتهم إياهم لا تكون إلا لغرض نفساني وكذا استعباد الموالي لخدمهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What God left as a sign is the enduring trace of that revealed law and prophetic call, preserved to the author's present as a clear lesson.
rows.anchor: آثار تلك الشريعة والدعوة إلى يومنا هذا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The call asks whether anyone will take admonition, since the path of truth is one and all prophets agree on the foundations of revealed laws.
rows.anchor: متعظ، فإن طريق الحق واحد والأنبياء كلهم متوافقون في أصول الشرائع
